caption: The drawing depicts a single statue of a standing human figure rendered in shades of tan, brown, and muted gray, giving it the appearance of being carved from aged wood. The figure has long hair partially covered with a cloak or drapery that hangs over both shoulders and down to the feet. The person is wearing a long, classical garment that gathers at the waist and reveals part of the right leg. They are barefoot, standing on a small platform with swirled decorations at the base. The figure’s right hand is holding a lyre, resting it against their body, while the left hand is strumming the strings. The facial features are clearly defined, with forward-facing eyes and subtle shading to indicate depth. Below the statue, the text "MUSE WITH A LYRE" is centered and printed in uppercase letters. The background is a plain off-white color without additional objects or details.
title: Muse with Lyre
